steps.what: skim milk powder, 100 g per litre of water, with litmus and sodium sulfite
steps.note: Litmus at 0.5 g per litre (0.075 g in another recipe), sodium sulfite 0.5 g per litre, pH about 6.8.
Autoclaved at 12 lb pressure for 15 min, in one recipe.

processing.text: The medium is made from skim milk powder in water, not from liquid skimmed milk.

links.name: Virtual Labs: Litmus milk test, procedure

sources.text: Microbe Online for the ingredients and pH; Virtual Labs for the autoclaving, whose pressure I read as about 121 degrees C. Neither gives the tube volume, and the two differ on how much litmus.
